Various mapart created by the players on Enthusia SMP.

== 1x1 ==
{{#dpl:
  |namespace=File
  |uses=Template:Mapart
  |include={Mapart¦Mapart.dpl}
  |includematch=/size\s*=\s*1x1/
  |mode=userformat
  |escapelinks=false
  |listseparators=,,,
}}
